COMPUTER ENGINEER - SENIOR FRONTEND DEVELOPER -
AI ENGINEER / LLM SPECIALIST IN TRANSITION
hero.lead: Computer Engineer with over 8 years of experience in software development. Strong logical-mathematical foundation and complex algorithm resolution. Specialist in Advanced JavaScript, Vue.js, Nuxt.js, React, and Angular, with Fullstack integration in PHP (Laravel, Yii2) and Node.js. Backend development with REST APIs, Docker and SQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle). AI-assisted programming using Cursor, custom rules, skills and MCPs. Cybersecurity principles and DevOps best practices. Actively transitioning to AI Engineer / LLM Specialist.
